stdin_key.description: If true, read text to type from stdin. Default is false (empty string implies command line text or keys).

text.description: The literal text string to type using -k internally or passed as argument.

sleep_before.description: Sleep for TIME milliseconds before interpreting the following options.

modifiers_press.description: List of modifier keys to press. Valid: shift, capslock, ctrl, logo, win, alt, altgr.

typed_keys.description: List of named keys to type (press and release). Valid: Left, Home, etc.

modifiers_release.description: List of modifier keys to release.

sleep_between.description: Sleep for TIME milliseconds between keystrokes.
